stage.note: use.computer's SDKs are published under Daytona's own npm org (@daytona) and PyPI namespace (daytona-use-computer); its listed npm maintainers (mdzaja, gdraganic) are members of the daytonaio GitHub org, and support is routed to support@daytona.io. Treated as a Daytona product line (macOS sandboxes) rather than an independently-funded company; funding figures below are Daytona's company-level rounds, not a separate use.computer raise, which could not be found.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of Daytona's disclosed rounds per Daytona's own press releases: $2M pre-seed (Nov 2023) + $5M seed (Jun 2024) + $24M Series A (reported early 2026)
total_funding_usd.quote: Daytona has raised a $24M Series A led by FirstMark Capital to build the infrastructure that makes this possible.

last_round.quote: Daytona has raised a $24M Series A led by FirstMark Capital to build the infrastructure that makes this possible. Matt Turck, General Partner at FirstMark, joins the board.

note: use.computer is a macOS-VM computer-use sandbox product whose SDKs (PyPI daytona-use-computer, npm @daytona/use-computer) are published under Daytona's own namespaces and whose listed npm maintainers are members of the daytonaio GitHub org; support requests are routed to support@daytona.io. Its own Terms of Service reference a distinct legal entity, 'Crucible Fund LLC' (effective 2026-06-03), which could not be independently reconciled with Daytona's corporate entity in the time available, so the ownership/parent link is medium- rather than high-confidence. No use.computer-specific funding round, valuation, or revenue figure was found; figures above are Daytona's company-level, publicly announced rounds (pre-seed $2M Nov 2023, seed $5M Jun 2024 led by Upfront Ventures, Series A $24M led by FirstMark Capital, reported ~Feb 2026).
